{{Quote|&laquo;Siynce when do we care what the Empiyre thiynks?&raquo;<br />"Since Grand Admiral Thrawn took command. I've heard stories of this warlord, Par'tah. It was he who forced my world under the Imperial shroud.|quotestart=0|[[Par'tah]] and [[Brasck]]|<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''occupied''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Baros]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Brubb]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Prelude==
At some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="date">According to many sourcebooks, such as ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was created in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> and [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="map" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Baros]] came to the attention of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when a [[Haba (Brubbs)|group]] of [[Brubb]] [[Astronomer/Legends|astronomers]], postulating that their planet was not the only [[Sentience/Legends|civilized]] world in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], began beaming coded messages into [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>

A cargo [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] intercepted one of these messages and reported it to the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], who then dispatched a [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] to investigate its origin.<ref name="GG4" />

==The occupation==
Considered part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of its discovery, the planet Baros was found by [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].<ref name="HES" /> Thrawn played a pivotal role in the occupation of Baros,<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref> teaching the Brubbs to fear and respect the might of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="HES" />

By 0 ABY, Baros was integrated into the [[Dominus sector/Legends|Dominus sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="map" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I cannot and will not stand against Grand Admiral Thrawn. To give information to the New Republic would be to invite his hatred and wrath upon me. But I will also not interfere with your activities or bring them to his attention.|[[Brasck]], to [[Talon Karrde]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after being forced into Imperial servitude, the Brubbs' fear of the Galactic Empire still ran deep.<ref name="TLC" /> During the [[Thrawn campaign]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Thrawn's confederation|forces]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] Thrawn [[Battle of Baros|attacked]] the [[Baros system/Legends|Baros system]] once again.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Several [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the attack,<ref name="TEA" /> the Brubb [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Brasck]] declined [[Talon Karrde]]'s offer to join the [[Smugglers' Alliance]] during a [[Ambush on Trogan|meeting]] at [[Whistler's Whirlpool Tapcafe|Whistler's Whirlpool]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] on [[Trogan/Legends|Trogan]].<ref name="TLC" /> Remembering stories of Thrawn from when he was a child on Baros, Brasck knew too well what the Empire did to traitors,<ref name="GG11" /> and feared Grand Admiral Thrawn especially.<ref name="HES" />
